integrity: Two standalone standard-library enumerators with distinct state-generation and switch-generation methods reconstruct the same complete 6240-vertex, 17640-edge certificate and all-pairs breadth-first eccentricities. All computations are finite; no external independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: This is the exhaustive fixed-vertex-labeled K8 1-factorization four-cycle switching graph only. The 6240 total count and the isolation of perfect factorizations are established prior results, not new. Unindexed full labeled computations may overlap the retained connectivity and diameter classification.
title: Exact labeled four-cycle switching geometry of \(K_8\) one-factorizations
